description_en: Ignores the evaluation results of some resources in an account group based on a specific rule. You can also specify a time period for ignoring the evaluation results. After the period elapses, the evaluation results of the resources based on the rule are automatically displayed
description_zh: 忽略某个账号组下某条规则对某些资源的评估结果。您还可以设置规则的忽略时间，当忽略到期后，自动恢复显示该规则对资源的检测结果
kebab_example: aliyun config ignore-aggregate-evaluation-results --config-rule-id cr-7e72626622af00510000 --resources ResourceId=lb-hp3a3b4ztyfm2plgm0000 Region=cn-beijing ResourceType=ACS::SLB::LoadBalancer ResourceAccountId=1208863178610000 --aggregator-id ca-5b6c626622af008f0000 --reason '无需检测。' --ignore-date 2022-06-01 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: IgnoreAggregateEvaluationResults

If you leave this parameter empty, the system does not automatically re-evaluate the ignored incompliant resources. You must manually re-evaluate the ignored incompliant resources
